## Objective
- Execute the full Fase-5/s6 package: read real gateway/contracts/SDK typings, fix the gateway so the judge policy is sent via AI SDK 7 `instructions` (fixing the `AI_InvalidPromptError`), add a wire-request regression test, adjust only Prettier-generated lint issues without disabling security rules, and deliver mandatory gates + report.
- Hard constraints: no real AI calls, no manual git/build/typecheck, preserve installed SDK versions and confirm typings.

## Important Details
- Installed versions: `ai@7.0.143`, `@ai-sdk/openai@4.0.96` (do not change `package.json` versions).
- SDK 7 rejects `role: "system"` inside `messages` before any request: `AI_InvalidPromptError: Invalid prompt: System messages are not allowed in the prompt or messages fields. Use the instructions option instead.` Typecheck does not catch it.
- Confirmed typings: `Instructions = string | SystemModelMessage | Array<SystemModelMessage>`; `SystemModelMessage.content: string` (string only, so split is type-safe); `streamText` options include `Prompt` (`instructions`), `messages`, `providerOptions`, `output`.
- `providerOptions.openai` supports `store`, `forceReasoning`, `reasoningEffort`, `reasoningSummary`, `include`.
- Official skill docs (`/tmp/knowledge/skill/ai-apps-openai-responses/references/requests.md` + `examples/responses.ts`): pass system prompt as `instructions`; keep `messages` to user/assistant/tool; provider created per request; preserve `store:false` + 4 reasoning options; call via `provider.responses(model)`.
- Edit scope per PRD: only `src/lib/ai/gateway/evaluate-call.server.ts`, new `src/test/ai/gateway.test.ts`, and `eslint.config.js`. Do NOT modify `src/lib/ai/prompt-injection.ts` (its system+user pair must be preserved; split happens in the gateway).
- Prettier config: `printWidth:100`, `semi:true`, `singleQuote:false`, `trailingComma:"all"`; `.prettierignore` excludes `node_modules`, `dist`, `bun.lock`, `routeTree.gen.ts`.
- ESLint: `eslint-plugin-prettier/recommended` applied last; security-relevant rules (`no-restricted-imports` for `server-only`) must stay. `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` is off.
- Vitest: `environment:"jsdom"`, `globals:true`, `setupFiles:["./src/test/setup.ts"]`, include `src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}`, alias `@` → `./src`.
- Adapter error mapping: `EvaluationOutputError` → code `schema` → needs_review, non-retryable; plain `Error` → `unknown` → needs_review, non-retryable; 429/5xx retried; `TypeError` → `network`.
- Prior failure evidence: `.opencode/work/sub/fase-5/s4-calibracao/log-s4-calibracao.txt` line ~10412 shows the `AI_InvalidPromptError`; report at `.opencode/work/sub/fase-5/s4-calibracao/report-s4-calibracao.md`.
- Real, non-network scratch verification is acceptable (`/tmp` script with stubbed `globalThis.fetch`); real AI calls are forbidden.
- Gateway base URL: `https://ai.gateway.lovable.dev/v1`; final endpoint `/v1/responses`; headers `Lovable-API-Key`, `X-Lovable-AIG-SDK: vercel-ai-sdk`, `X-Lovable-AIG-Run-ID`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Read real files: `src/lib/ai/gateway/evaluate-call.server.ts`, `gateway-helpers.ts`, `responses.ts`, `run-id.ts`, `src/lib/ai/prompt-injection.ts`, `judge-policy.ts`, `evaluate.server.ts`, `adapter.server.ts` (lines 360–560), `errors.ts`, `src/test/ai/adapter.test.ts`, `eslint.config.js`, `.prettierrc`, `.prettierignore`, `vitest.config.ts`, `package.json`.
- Confirmed `buildEvaluatorMessages(systemPrompt, untrusted)` returns `[{role:"system", content: systemPrompt.trim() + "\n\n" + UNTRUSTED_RULE}, {role:"user", content: <wrapped untrusted>}]`.
- Reproduced the exact failure offline with `/tmp/scratch-gw.ts` (stub fetch, no network) against the unmodified gateway.
- Edited `src/lib/ai/gateway/evaluate-call.server.ts`:
  - import changed to `import { NoObjectGeneratedError, Output, streamText, type ModelMessage } from "ai";`
  - added exported `splitEvaluatorPrompt(messages: readonly ModelMessage[]): { instructions: string; messages: ModelMessage[] }`, joins system contents with `\n\n`, throws `EvaluationOutputError("prompt do avaliador sem instruções de sistema")` if none.
  - in `createGatewayEvaluationCall`: `const prompt = splitEvaluatorPrompt(buildEvaluatorMessages(input.systemPrompt, input.untrusted));` then `streamText({ model: provider.responses(model), instructions: prompt.instructions, messages: prompt.messages, output: Output.object({ schema: judgeOutputSchema }), ... })`.
- Re-ran scratch: wire request is now valid — URL `https://ai.gateway.lovable.dev/v1/responses`; body `input[0] = {role:"developer", content: "<POLÍTICA DO JUIZ>\n\n<UNTRUSTED_RULE>"}`, `input[1] = {role:"user", content:[{type:"input_text", text:"...\n<<<RESPOSTA_DO_ALUNO>>>\nresposta do aluno\n<<<END_RESPOSTA_DO_ALUNO>>>"}]}`; `text.format = {type:"json_schema", strict:true, name:"response", schema:{...}}`. No `role:"system"` item, no top-level `messages`.

### Active
- Verify tail of `/tmp/scratch-gw.ts` output (`=== RESULT ===`) to confirm `result.output` parses the fake SSE into the judge object (output was truncated at 160 lines).
- Write `src/test/ai/gateway.test.ts`: stub `globalThis.fetch`, build minimal Responses SSE (`response.created`, `response.output_item.added` with `item.type:"message"`, `response.output_text.delta` with JSON, `response.output_item.done`, `response.completed` with usage), then assert:
  1. request URL ends `/v1/responses` and headers include `lovable-api-key` + `x-lovable-aig-sdk: vercel-ai-sdk`;
  2. policy + `UNTRUSTED_RULE` present exactly once in the non-user `input` item;
  3. no item with `role:"system"`; user item carries the delimiters and escaping;
  4. `text.format.type === "json_schema"`, `strict === true`, root `type:"object"`;
  5. `store === false` and `forceReasoning/reasoningEffort/reasoningSummary/include` preserved;
  6. normalized result returned; invalid/empty output → `EvaluationOutputError` (NoObjectGeneratedError path).

### Blocked
- Result of scratch parse not yet seen (output truncated).
- Lint/prettier gate not yet run; unknown whether `eslint.config.js` needs a Prettier-only adjustment.
- Report and gate outputs not yet produced.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the remaining scratch output to confirm `result.output` shape, then create `src/test/ai/gateway.test.ts` with the wire-request assertions above (fake `fetch` only, no network).
2. Run the mandatory gates (`bun run lint` / `bun run test` as defined in `package.json`), fix only Prettier-generated noise (in `eslint.config.js` if unavoidable), report any remaining rule violations without disabling them, and write the s6 report under `.opencode/work/sub/fase-5/s6-integration/`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/lib/ai/gateway/evaluate-call.server.ts`: edited gateway; now exports `splitEvaluatorPrompt` and sends `instructions` + user-only `messages`.
- `src/test/ai/gateway.test.ts`: new regression test to be authored (does not exist yet).
- `src/lib/ai/prompt-injection.ts`: `buildEvaluatorMessages`, `UNTRUSTED_RULE`, `wrapUntrusted`, `escapeDelimiters` — read-only, must not change.
- `src/lib/ai/judge-policy.ts`: `JUDGE_POLICY`, `JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION = "judge-policy@1"` — system prompt source.
- `src/lib/ai/adapter.server.ts`: `classify`/`failureResult` retry semantics that the gateway errors must map into.
- `src/lib/ai/errors.ts`: `EvaluationOutputError` (code `schema`), `MissingApiKeyError`.
- `src/lib/ai/gateway/run-id.ts`, `gateway-helpers.ts`, `responses.ts`: run-ID fetch wrapper and reference shapes — unchanged.
- `src/lib/ai/evaluate.server.ts`, `calibration.server.ts`: consumers of `createGatewayEvaluationCall({})`.
- `vitest.config.ts`, `src/test/setup.ts`, `src/test/ai/adapter.test.ts`: test harness pattern to mirror.
- `eslint.config.js`, `.prettierrc`, `.prettierignore`: Prettier/lint gate config; only Prettier-generated adjustments allowed.
- `.opencode/work/sub/fase-5/s4-calibracao/log-s4-calibracao.txt` (line ~10412) and `report-s4-calibracao.md`: original `AI_InvalidPromptError` evidence.
- `.opencode/work/sub/fase-5/s6-integration/`: destination for s6 gates/report (`log-s6.jsonl`, `prd-project1-s6`, `roadmap-proj1-s6` exist).
- `/tmp/scratch-gw.ts`: offline fetch-stub harness confirming the wire request.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

part.text:
## Feito

- **`src/lib/ai/gateway/evaluate-call.server.ts`** — SDK 7 corrigido: `splitEvaluatorPrompt` separa a política do juiz (`SYSTEM_PROMPT` + `UNTRUSTED_RULE`) e envia `instructions: prompt.instructions` com `messages` só de turnos não confiáveis. Preservados Responses, modelo, `store:false`, `forceReasoning:true`, effort `medium`, summary `auto`, encrypted reasoning, `maxRetries:0`, cancelamento e provider/run-id por chamada. `prompt-injection.ts` intocado.
- **`src/test/ai/gateway.test.ts`** (novo) — 6 casos com SDK real + `fetch` fake/SSE Responses: URL/headers, política em um único turno confiável e ausente do `user`, zero `system` na conversa, `messages` inexistente no wire, schema estrito (raiz object, required completo vs `judgeOutputSchema.shape`, `additionalProperties:false`), `store`/reasoning/include, saída normalizada, saída vazia → `EvaluationOutputError`, sem chave → `MissingApiKeyError` sem request.
- **`eslint.config.js`** — override só de `prettier/prettier: off` em `src/integrations/supabase/**/*.{ts,tsx}`; todas as outras regras preservadas.
- **`report-s6-integration.md`** + decisões no PRD e checkboxes no roadmap do pacote.

## Verificado

- `bunx vitest run src/test/ai/gateway.test.ts src/test/ai/adapter.test.ts --maxWorkers=2` → **2 arquivos, 22 testes verdes**.
- Prova de regressão: revertendo o gateway ao código antigo, **5/6** casos falham (erro de prompt/sem request); restaurado e verde de novo.
- `bunx eslint src --format json` → **1 erro, 6 warnings** (warnings preexistentes). Os 172 erros iniciais caíram para 1.
- Wire real do SDK inspecionado offline: `input[0] = developer` com política + `UNTRUSTED_RULE`, `input[1] = user` delimitado, `text.format` json_schema estrito. Nenhuma chamada real de IA, nenhum build/typecheck manual, nenhum git de escrita.

## Pendência

- Erro residual **não silenciado** por instrução: `src/integrations/supabase/previewAuthStorage.ts:38` — `prefer-const` em arquivo autogerado (a correção sugerida seria inválida: variável lida antes da atribuição). O `no-explicit-any` citado no diagnóstico não existe mais no scaffold. Precisa de decisão do principal (regenerar scaffold, opção da regra ou aceitar o resíduo).
- Nota: a plataforma auto-commitou em `44ebf7e` (00:19 UTC); só os pilares/logs do pacote ficaram fora do commit.
